meta.description: Queue for newly detected terms during Lexicon Out checks requiring operational definition and role validation.
meta.routing_rule: Every newly introduced term during a governed run MUST be added here with status GAP_OPEN.
meta.cleanup_rule: The gap queue should trend toward empty by resolving, promoting, aliasing, deprecating, or classifying terms as unresolvable gaps. Allowed terminal states: RESOLVED_TO_CANONICAL, RESOLVED_TO_ALIAS, RESOLVED_TO_NOISE, DEPRECATED, UNRESOLVABLE_GAP.

common_language_noise_filter_v1.exception_rule: If a common word is explicitly claimed as a governed primitive, route to manual charter review instead of noise.

noun_to_verb_acceptance_rule_v1.statement: A noun may be accepted when its canonical definition reduces to an active process form and does not imply object, container, substrate, location, or substance primitivity.

cross_class_collision_detection_v1.name: cross_class_collision_detection_v1
cross_class_collision_detection_v1.description: A term may not simultaneously exist as incompatible ontology classes without explicit governance exemption.

operator_signature_validation_v1.name: operator_signature_validation_v1
operator_signature_validation_v1.description: Operators must declare typed input/output signatures compatible with ontology classes.

illegal_cross_space_projection_v1.name: illegal_cross_space_projection_v1
illegal_cross_space_projection_v1.description: Operators may not directly transform between incompatible spaces without an explicit projection or transition operator.

state_space_transition_legality_v1.name: state_space_transition_legality_v1
state_space_transition_legality_v1.statement: No operator may transform between state spaces unless its operator_signature declares compatible source_space and target_space fields.

constraint_geometry_not_substrate_v1.name: constraint_geometry_not_substrate_v1
constraint_geometry_not_substrate_v1.statement: Constraint Geometry must not be treated as primitive space, container, or background manifold.

constraint_geometry_not_physics_claim_v1.name: constraint_geometry_not_physics_claim_v1
constraint_geometry_not_physics_claim_v1.statement: Constraint Geometry may be used as theoretical PCD structure but must not be presented as an empirical physical geometry without recoverable validation.

no_incomplete_law_set_promotion_v1.name: no_incomplete_law_set_promotion_v1
no_incomplete_law_set_promotion_v1.statement: Participation-only, residue-only, or transition-only descriptions must not be promoted as complete PCD law chains.

no_static_constraint_geometry_v1.name: no_static_constraint_geometry_v1
no_static_constraint_geometry_v1.statement: Constraint Geometry must not be treated as immutable background structure.

no_geometry_without_process_v1.name: no_geometry_without_process_v1
no_geometry_without_process_v1.statement: Constraint Geometry may not exist independently of admissible continuation processes.

no_literal_curvature_claim_v1.name: no_literal_curvature_claim_v1
no_literal_curvature_claim_v1.statement: Curvature language within PCD refers to admissibility deformation unless explicitly tied to validated physical interpretation.

no_complete_observable_recovery_v1.name: no_complete_observable_recovery_v1
no_complete_observable_recovery_v1.statement: A projected observable must not be assumed to uniquely determine the full underlying continuation structure unless reconstruction legality is explicitly demonstrated.

no_inverse_projection_without_history_v1.name: no_inverse_projection_without_history_v1
no_inverse_projection_without_history_v1.statement: Reconstruction claims require admissibility history and residue context; observable inversion without process history is incomplete.

simulation_validation_binding_v1.name: simulation_validation_binding_v1
simulation_validation_binding_v1.statement: Simulation outputs may not be classified as valid PCD evidence unless generated through a pipeline-compliant admissibility chain.

reconstruction_validation_binding_v1.name: reconstruction_validation_binding_v1
reconstruction_validation_binding_v1.statement: Inverse reconstruction claims must declare projection resolution, residue context, and admissibility history.

partial_derivation_gap_tracking_v1.name: partial_derivation_gap_tracking_v1
partial_derivation_gap_tracking_v1.statement: Partially derived terms may be canonical only if unresolved mathematical gaps are explicitly listed and routed to proof or operator-algebra work.

no_memoryless_update_v1.name: no_memoryless_update_v1
no_memoryless_update_v1.statement: A transition using δ or NavT must not be treated as complete unless its residue or admissibility context is declared.

no_static_existence_update_v1.name: no_static_existence_update_v1
no_static_existence_update_v1.statement: E_alpha > 0 may establish participation, but may not by itself imply continuation or motion.

no_passive_residue_agency_v1.name: no_passive_residue_agency_v1
no_passive_residue_agency_v1.statement: R may constrain or condition updates, but must not be described as acting independently outside process continuation.

illegal_operator_chains_v1.name: direct_participation_to_observable
illegal_operator_chains_v1.reason: Participation alone does not generate observable continuation.

illegal_operator_chains_v1.name: memoryless_transition
illegal_operator_chains_v1.reason: Transition without admissibility or residue mediation is incomplete.

illegal_operator_chains_v1.name: residue_as_independent_agent
illegal_operator_chains_v1.reason: Residue may condition transitions but must not independently generate them.

illegal_operator_chains_v1.name: topology_as_primitive_container
illegal_operator_chains_v1.reason: Topology constrains continuation but is not a substrate containing process.

observable_projection_guardrail_v1.name: observable_projection_guardrail_v1
observable_projection_guardrail_v1.statement: Observables are projections of constrained continuation and must not be treated as direct primitives of the framework.

no_absolute_observable_v1.name: no_absolute_observable_v1
no_absolute_observable_v1.statement: Observables must not be treated as absolute primitives independent of projection context.

no_projection_without_transition_v1.name: no_projection_without_transition_v1
no_projection_without_transition_v1.statement: Projection operators may not generate observables directly from participation conditions without admissible transition structure.

no_resolution_independent_observable_v1.name: no_resolution_independent_observable_v1
no_resolution_independent_observable_v1.statement: Observable identity must not be assumed invariant across all projection resolutions unless explicitly demonstrated.

no_untyped_law_claims_v1.name: no_untyped_law_claims_v1
no_untyped_law_claims_v1.statement: No PCD law may be promoted unless it declares ontology role, state space, operator dependencies, and claim classification.

no_law_as_external_command_v1.name: no_law_as_external_command_v1
no_law_as_external_command_v1.statement: PCD laws must be described as stable update invariances or process constraints, not external commands imposed on process.

no_chain_without_admissibility_v1.name: no_chain_without_admissibility_v1
no_chain_without_admissibility_v1.statement: A linked transformation sequence without admissibility mediation must not be promoted as a valid process chain.

no_recursive_projection_collapse_v1.name: no_recursive_projection_collapse_v1
no_recursive_projection_collapse_v1.statement: Projected observables must not be recursively treated as primitive generators of their own continuation chain without explicit projection inversion logic.

no_disconnected_chain_segments_v1.name: no_disconnected_chain_segments_v1
no_disconnected_chain_segments_v1.statement: Adjacent operators within a process chain must share compatible ontology outputs and inputs.

formal_stack_lock_dependency_v1.name: formal_stack_lock_dependency_v1
formal_stack_lock_dependency_v1.statement: Any future ontology, operator, simulation, or publication patch must cite the current PCD formal stack lockfile or explicitly declare incompatibility.

no_unbound_theorem_claims_v1.name: no_unbound_theorem_claims_v1
no_unbound_theorem_claims_v1.statement: No theorem, lemma, or proof claim may be promoted into the formal PCD stack unless it is bound to a registry entry, dependency path, and claim classification.

lemma_requires_traceable_source_v1.name: lemma_requires_traceable_source_v1
lemma_requires_traceable_source_v1.statement: All governed lemmas must bind to a source document, proof state, and dependency chain.

no_simulation_claim_without_binding_v1.name: no_simulation_claim_without_binding_v1
no_simulation_claim_without_binding_v1.statement: A simulation result may not support a PCD claim unless the tool is bound to tested lemmas, operators, law chains, and provenance requirements.

no_claim_support_above_tool_rigor endors.name: no_claim_support_above_tool_rigor endorsement_v1
no_claim_support_above_tool_rigor endors.statement: A tool may not support a claim class higher than its rigor endorsement level permits.

no_lemma_support_without_operator_instan.name: no_lemma_support_without_operator_instantiation_v1
no_lemma_support_without_operator_instan.statement: A simulation may not be recorded as testing a lemma unless it instantiates the operators required by that lemma dependency chain.

no_claim_without_support_matrix_entry_v1.name: no_claim_without_support_matrix_entry_v1
no_claim_without_support_matrix_entry_v1.statement: No governed PCD claim may be promoted in a paper, report, or validation artifact unless it has a claim_support_matrix entry.

no_claim_class_without_support_requireme.name: no_claim_class_without_support_requirements_v1
no_claim_class_without_support_requireme.statement: Every claim class must declare required lemmas, operators, law chains, simulation bindings, and provenance status.

no_publication_claim_without_publication.name: no_publication_claim_without_publication_allowed_v1
no_publication_claim_without_publication.statement: A claim may not appear as a publishable supported result unless publication_allowed is true.

no_paper_without_stack_header_v1.name: no_paper_without_stack_header_v1
no_paper_without_stack_header_v1.statement: Governed PCD papers must declare the active PCD formal stack version and compliance charter version.

no_empirical_claim_without_recoverable_a.name: no_empirical_claim_without_recoverable_artifact_v1
no_empirical_claim_without_recoverable_a.statement: Empirical claims in governed papers require recoverable output files and claim-support matrix binding.

no_theoretical_claim_without_math_bindin.name: no_theoretical_claim_without_math_binding_v1
no_theoretical_claim_without_math_bindin.statement: Theoretical claims require binding to math sources, lemmas, proofs, law chains, or formal-stack rules.

no_proof_without_registered_dependencies.name: no_proof_without_registered_dependencies_v1
no_proof_without_registered_dependencies.statement: A proof may not be promoted unless its lemma, term, operator, and gap dependencies are registered.

no_gap_closure_without_explicit_gap_id_v.name: no_gap_closure_without_explicit_gap_id_v1
no_gap_closure_without_explicit_gap_id_v.statement: A proof claiming to close a gap must identify the exact gap and state whether closure is complete, partial, or implementation-dependent.

no_gap_resolution_without_dependency_gra.name: no_gap_resolution_without_dependency_graph_entry_v1
no_gap_resolution_without_dependency_gra.statement: A mathematical gap may not be marked resolved unless its dependency graph entry is updated with closure requirements and downstream effects.

no_downstream_claim_promotion_with_open_.name: no_downstream_claim_promotion_with_open_gap_v1
no_downstream_claim_promotion_with_open_.statement: A claim depending on an open or partially closed gap may not be promoted beyond theoretical/provisional status unless the dependency is explicitly scoped.

no_theorem_language_without_status_v1.name: no_theorem_language_without_status_v1
no_theorem_language_without_status_v1.statement: A statement may not be called a theorem, lemma, proof, or derived result unless it has a theorem_status_registry classification.

no_unconditional_language_for_conditiona.name: no_unconditional_language_for_conditional_lemmas_v1
no_unconditional_language_for_conditiona.statement: TS2 conditional lemmas must preserve their stated assumptions and gap dependencies in publication language.

no_empirical_upgrade_without_artifacts_v.name: no_empirical_upgrade_without_artifacts_v1
no_empirical_upgrade_without_artifacts_v.statement: A theorem may not be promoted to simulation-supported status without recoverable governed artifacts and simulation-proof binding.

no_rhetorical_overpromotion_v1.name: no_rhetorical_overpromotion_v1
no_rhetorical_overpromotion_v1.statement: Publication language must not exceed the theorem status, claim class, or evidence level of the underlying result.

no_missing_uncertainty_scope_v1.name: no_missing_uncertainty_scope_v1
no_missing_uncertainty_scope_v1.statement: Conditional or provisional claims must preserve explicit uncertainty and dependency language.

no_universal_claim_language_v1.name: no_universal_claim_language_v1
no_universal_claim_language_v1.statement: Universal or absolute language is prohibited unless explicitly supported by governed external validation policy.

no_audience_scope_mismatch_v1.name: no_audience_scope_mismatch_v1
no_audience_scope_mismatch_v1.statement: Publication language must remain compatible with the declared audience scope and theorem status ceiling.

no_public_explanation_without_disclaimer.name: no_public_explanation_without_disclaimer_v1
no_public_explanation_without_disclaimer.statement: Public-facing explanations of PCD must preserve uncertainty, development status, and non-finality disclaimers.

no_grandiose_summary_language_v1.name: no_grandiose_summary_language_v1
no_grandiose_summary_language_v1.statement: Summaries and abstracts must avoid rhetoric implying universal completion, total unification, or finality.

no_unbounded_validation_inheritance_v1.name: no_unbounded_validation_inheritance_v1
no_unbounded_validation_inheritance_v1.statement: Inherited validation may not exceed the evidence scope, theorem status, or operator legality of its source.

no_alias_validation_without_canonical_bi.name: no_alias_validation_without_canonical_binding_v1
no_alias_validation_without_canonical_bi.statement: Aliases may inherit validation only from canonical targets with active validation entries.

no_shorthand_reification_v1.name: no_shorthand_reification_v1
no_shorthand_reification_v1.statement: Derived shorthand terms may not inherit primitive status.

no_format_token_canonicalization_v1.name: no_format_token_canonicalization_v1
no_format_token_canonicalization_v1.statement: Markdown, LaTeX fragments, parser residue, punctuation fragments, and document-format tokens must not be promoted as canonical terms without explicit human approval.

math_symbol_requires_context_v1.name: math_symbol_requires_context_v1
math_symbol_requires_context_v1.statement: A mathematical symbol may be canonical only if it has a declared role, source context, definition mode, and ontology class.

semantic_drift_flagging_v1.name: semantic_drift_flagging_v1
semantic_drift_flagging_v1.statement: Terms with known drift patterns must be flagged for context review before promotion, publication, or automated correction.

no_auto_correction_without_context_v1.name: no_auto_correction_without_context_v1
no_auto_correction_without_context_v1.statement: Potential semantic substitutions must not be automatically corrected when both observed and intended forms may be meaningful in context.

no_unprojected_transport_update_v1.name: no_unprojected_transport_update_v1
no_unprojected_transport_update_v1.statement: Transport/NavT contributions must not be treated as admissible updates unless projected through Π_A and evaluated by gate.

no_residue_write_without_admissible_tran.name: no_residue_write_without_admissible_transition_v1
no_residue_write_without_admissible_tran.statement: Residue update claims require an admissible transition condition and explicit Ψ behavior.

no_runtime_rule_without_rulepack_v1.name: no_runtime_rule_without_rulepack_v1
no_runtime_rule_without_rulepack_v1.statement: Any governance rule expected to execute at runtime must be registered in runtime_rulepack_registry.json.

no_dependency_failure_without_cascade_re.name: no_dependency_failure_without_cascade_review_v1
no_dependency_failure_without_cascade_re.statement: Any failed, contested, superseded, or falsified formal object must trigger dependency cascade review before dependent claims remain active.

no_claim_survival_after_support_loss_v1.name: no_claim_survival_after_support_loss_v1
no_claim_survival_after_support_loss_v1.statement: A claim may not retain its support status after losing a required proof, lemma, tool rigor endorsement, or gap closure dependency.

no_governed_object_without_formal_object.name: no_governed_object_without_formal_object_identity_v1
no_governed_object_without_formal_object.statement: Governed lemmas, proofs, gaps, claims, and operators must eventually resolve to formal_object identities.

no_fragmented_dependency_reference_v1.name: no_fragmented_dependency_reference_v1
no_fragmented_dependency_reference_v1.statement: Cross-registry dependencies should resolve through shared formal-object references where available.

no_raw_cross_registry_reference_v1.name: no_raw_cross_registry_reference_v1
no_raw_cross_registry_reference_v1.statement: Cross-registry dependency references should resolve through formal_object identities whenever available.

no_duplicate_formal_object_identity_v1.name: no_duplicate_formal_object_identity_v1
no_duplicate_formal_object_identity_v1.statement: A governed object may not resolve to multiple conflicting formal-object identities.

no_unreviewed_consistency_conflict_v1.name: no_unreviewed_consistency_conflict_v1
no_unreviewed_consistency_conflict_v1.statement: Detected contradictions or consistency failures must be resolved, scoped, or downgraded before dependent claims remain active.

no_silent_dependency_override_v1.name: no_silent_dependency_override_v1
no_silent_dependency_override_v1.statement: A registry entry may not override a weaker dependency status without explicit theorem-status or claim-support review.

no_theorem_promotion_without_closure_ana.name: no_theorem_promotion_without_closure_analysis_v1
no_theorem_promotion_without_closure_ana.statement: No lemma, proof, or theorem may be promoted without a theorem_closure_registry entry.

no_closed_status_with_open_gap_v1.name: no_closed_status_with_open_gap_v1
no_closed_status_with_open_gap_v1.statement: A theorem depending on an open or partially closed gap may not be marked closed unless scoped as conditional.

no_proof_overclaim_without_saturation_v1.name: no_proof_overclaim_without_saturation_v1
no_proof_overclaim_without_saturation_v1.statement: A proof may not claim more lemma coverage than its registered dependencies and assumptions support.

no_saturated_status_with_missing_operato.name: no_saturated_status_with_missing_operator_v1
no_saturated_status_with_missing_operato.statement: A proof cannot be marked saturated if a required operator, term, or gap dependency is missing or unresolved.

no_stable_minimizer_switch_without_condi.name: no_stable_minimizer_switch_without_conditions_v1
no_stable_minimizer_switch_without_condi.statement: A minimizer switch may not be described as stable unless admissibility, bounded mismatch, Ref(.) equivalence, and recoupling/degeneracy conditions are declared.

no_full_minus_i_closure_without_MST_proo.name: no_full_minus_i_closure_without_MST_proof_v1
no_full_minus_i_closure_without_MST_proo.statement: -(i) may not be promoted from partially derived to fully derived until MST-001 is proven or superseded by a stronger theorem.

no_full_metric_claim_without_metric_proo.name: no_full_metric_claim_without_metric_proof_v1
no_full_metric_claim_without_metric_proo.statement: d_Omega must not be described as a full metric until identity, symmetry, triangle inequality, and quotient behavior are proven or scoped.

no_single_reference_distance_for_degener.name: no_single_reference_distance_for_degenerate_set_v1
no_single_reference_distance_for_degener.statement: Set-valued -(i) references require declared set-distance behavior or must remain unresolved.

no_metric_language_for_d_Omega_without_q.name: no_metric_language_for_d_Omega_without_quotient_proof_v1
no_metric_language_for_d_Omega_without_q.statement: d_Omega must be called a pseudometric or metric scaffold unless metric axioms are proven on orientation_space / ~_Ref.

no_zero_distance_identity_claim_v1.name: no_zero_distance_identity_claim_v1
no_zero_distance_identity_claim_v1.statement: d_Omega(a,b)=0 implies Ref(.) equivalence, not object identity or absolute sameness.

no_non_idempotent_projection_v1.name: no_non_idempotent_projection_v1
no_non_idempotent_projection_v1.statement: Pi_A must be idempotent; multiple projections of the same increment into a stable window must not change the result.

no_unprojected_transport_accumulation_v1.name: no_unprojected_transport_accumulation_v1
no_unprojected_transport_accumulation_v1.statement: Transport contributions must be projected through Pi_A before they are summed or applied to state updates.

no_associative_transport_without_residua.name: no_associative_transport_without_residual_check_v1
no_associative_transport_without_residua.statement: Transport composition must not be assumed associative (NavT(a,b) ∘ NavT(b,c) = NavT(a,c)) unless the residual delta_T is proven to be zero.

no_identity_transport_drift_v1.name: no_identity_transport_drift_v1
no_identity_transport_drift_v1.statement: NavT(a,a) must evaluate to identity; any nonzero result indicates illegal reference or phase drift.

no_non_local_transport_without_path_vali.name: no_non_local_transport_without_path_validity_v1
no_non_local_transport_without_path_vali.statement: Non-local transport claims must show an admissible chain of local coupling neighbors and a bounded total transport residual.

no_instantaneous_non_local_coupling_v1.name: no_instantaneous_non_local_coupling_v1
no_instantaneous_non_local_coupling_v1.statement: Non-local interaction must propagate through intermediate NavT composition unless a verified non-local mechanism (e.g., long-range graph edge) is explicitly declared.

no_OASSOC_promotion_with_pending_obligat.name: no_OASSOC_promotion_with_pending_obligations_v1
no_OASSOC_promotion_with_pending_obligat.statement: OASSOC-001 may not promote while any required proof obligation remains pending or blocked.

no_P008_scaffold_as_full_associativity_p.name: no_P008_scaffold_as_full_associativity_proof_v1
no_P008_scaffold_as_full_associativity_p.statement: P008 may support conditional discharge review but must not be treated as a full proof of global O associativity.

no_associativity_without_restriction_sco.name: no_associativity_without_restriction_scope_v1
no_associativity_without_restriction_sco.statement: Any associativity language for O must explicitly preserve restricted-domain assumptions unless a stronger theorem supersedes OASSOC-001.

no_O_associativity_without_grouping_equi.name: no_O_associativity_without_grouping_equivalence_v1
no_O_associativity_without_grouping_equi.statement: Restricted associativity claims must show grouping equivalence in admissibility status, Ref(.) class, residue context, and transition legality.

no_restricted_associativity_as_global_as.name: no_restricted_associativity_as_global_associativity_v1
no_restricted_associativity_as_global_as.statement: Conditional discharge of OASSOC-001 does not imply global associativity of O composition.

no_MST_TS4_without_MSV001_v1.name: no_MST_TS4_without_MSV001_v1
no_MST_TS4_without_MSV001_v1.statement: MST-001 may not promote to simulation-supported theorem status without passing MSV-001 or a stricter successor validation plan.

no_recoupling_validation_single_mechanis.name: no_recoupling_validation_single_mechanism_v1
no_recoupling_validation_single_mechanis.statement: Residue-mediated recoupling validation requires at least two independent mechanism classes.

no_MSV001_run_without_config_schema_v1.name: no_MSV001_run_without_config_schema_v1
no_MSV001_run_without_config_schema_v1.statement: MSV-001 validation runs must use configs conforming to msv_001_experiment_config_schema.json.

no_MSV001_claim_without_required_observa.name: no_MSV001_claim_without_required_observables_v1
no_MSV001_claim_without_required_observa.statement: MSV-001 results may not support MST-001 or OASSOC-001 unless all required observables are present.

no_MSV001_reference_claim_without_two_co.name: no_MSV001_reference_claim_without_two_configs_v1
no_MSV001_reference_claim_without_two_co.statement: MSV-001 reference validation requires at least graph_dynamics and cellular_automata reference configs before TS4 eligibility.

no_MSV001_config_without_falsification_v.name: no_MSV001_config_without_falsification_vectors_v1
no_MSV001_config_without_falsification_v.statement: MSV-001 reference configs must include FV-1 through FV-4.

no_dry_run_as_theorem_support_v1.name: no_dry_run_as_theorem_support_v1
no_dry_run_as_theorem_support_v1.statement: MSV-001 dry-run outputs validate harness readiness only and must not support MST-001 or OASSOC-001 theorem promotion.

no_MSV001_execution_before_dry_run_pass_.name: no_MSV001_execution_before_dry_run_pass_v1
no_MSV001_execution_before_dry_run_pass_.statement: Full MSV-001 execution should not proceed until dry-run config and output validation scaffolds pass.

no_publication_support_language_without_.name: no_publication_support_language_without_binding_v1
no_publication_support_language_without_.statement: Publications may not use support or validation language unless linked to governed empirical result packages and claim ledger entries.

no_CB4_as_physical_proof_v1.name: no_CB4_as_physical_proof_v1
no_CB4_as_physical_proof_v1.statement: CB4 simulation-supported theorem behavior must not be described as physical proof, universal law, or final closure.

no_success_cascade_to_full_closure_v1.name: no_success_cascade_to_full_closure_v1
no_success_cascade_to_full_closure_v1.statement: Successful MSV-001 validation may support theorem promotion but must not automatically close -(i), O algebra, or d_Omega metric gaps.

no_cross_mechanism_claim_without_cross_m.name: no_cross_mechanism_claim_without_cross_mechanism_evidence_v1
no_cross_mechanism_claim_without_cross_m.statement: Cross-mechanism language requires at least two independent certified mechanisms.

no_high_confidence_without_provenance_v1.name: no_high_confidence_without_provenance_v1
no_high_confidence_without_provenance_v1.statement: CB3 or CB4 confidence classifications require recoverable provenance and runtime validation.

no_empirical_status_change_without_ledge.name: no_empirical_status_change_without_ledger_v1
no_empirical_status_change_without_ledge.statement: Empirical claim status may not change without a durable ledger entry recording source result, confidence band, artifacts, and reason.

no_restored_claim_without_rerigor endors.name: no_restored_claim_without_rerigor endorsement_event_v1
no_restored_claim_without_rerigor endors.statement: A downgraded or invalidated empirical claim may not be restored without rerigor endorsement, rerun validation, or explicit review event.

no_confidence_propagation_without_condit.name: no_confidence_propagation_without_conditions_v1
no_confidence_propagation_without_condit.statement: Empirical confidence may not propagate to theorem or claim status unless all required conditions for the confidence band are satisfied.

no_confidence_survival_after_runtime_dri.name: no_confidence_survival_after_runtime_drift_v1
no_confidence_survival_after_runtime_dri.statement: Empirical confidence must decay when runtime, provenance, rigor endorsement, or contradiction state changes.

no_silent_anomaly_absorption_v1.name: no_silent_anomaly_absorption_v1
no_silent_anomaly_absorption_v1.statement: Anomalous or contradictory simulation behavior must not be absorbed into supporting interpretation without a registered review lane.

no_supported_language_beyond_confidence_.name: no_supported_language_beyond_confidence_band_v1
no_supported_language_beyond_confidence_.statement: Publication language may not exceed the ceiling permitted by the linked confidence band and theorem status.

no_unresolved_gap_closure_language_v1.name: no_unresolved_gap_closure_language_v1
no_unresolved_gap_closure_language_v1.statement: Documents may not describe partially derived systems as fully closed while unresolved gaps remain active.

no_theorem_support_from_unresolved_contr.name: no_theorem_support_from_unresolved_contradiction_v1

proposed_roles.falsification_condition: Orientation pressure emerges despite CSI = 0 (disconnected basins).

candidate_new_terms.process_rewrite: Cancellation of admissible orientation biases in a coupled recursive loop.

proposed_roles.falsification_condition: Orientation equilibrium is unreachable or inherently unstable in all tested regimes.
